answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Miami car-accident lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, available insurance, fault disputes, and whether the case is likely to go to trial.

For a serious injury or contested-liability case, look for a **Miami-Dade attorney who is Florida Bar Board Certified in Civil Trial Law**, regularly handles auto-injury litigation, and will personally handle your case rather than immediately passing it to a case manager.

Well-known firms that handle Miami car-accident cases include:

- **Morgan & Morgan** — large firm with substantial resources; may be useful for complex/high-value cases.
- **The Law Offices of Anidjar & Levine** — handles Florida auto-accident and injury claims.
- **Dolman Law Group** — represents accident victims throughout South Florida.
- **Kaire & Heffernan** — Miami personal-injury firm with auto-accident experience.
- **Freidin Brown, P.A.** — established Miami trial firm, particularly worth considering for catastrophic-injury matters.

Before hiring anyone, schedule free consultations with at least two or three firms and ask:

1. **Will you personally handle my case and trial?**
2. **How many similar car-crash cases have you taken to trial?**
3. **What is your contingency fee, and what costs come out of any recovery?**
4. **Do you see any insurance-coverage or fault issues?**
5. **What is the realistic range of outcomes—not just the best-case scenario?**

Important Florida timing: for crashes occurring on or after March 24, 2023, many negligence claims generally have a **two-year** filing deadline, and Florida PIP benefits can require treatment within **14 days** of the crash. Do not wait to get legal advice.

A good first filter is the Florida Bar’s lawyer directory: search Miami-Dade lawyers and prioritize **Civil Trial Law board certification**, disciplinary history, and actual trial experience over advertising or online ratings.
